title: The Rajasthan Royals Star Hit 87 off 39 Balls in Texas. The MLC’s Match of the Season Was Only Getting Started.
excerpt: Lhuan-dre Pretorius tore apart Seattle’s bowling, Brody Couch sealed it with a boundary off the final over, and San Francisco Unicorns climbed to the top of the MLC standings with a two-wicket thriller at Grand Prairie.
body:
On a muggy Friday evening in Grand Prairie, Texas, with clouds blanketing the Dallas suburb and the temperature hovering around 23°C, 20-year-old Lhuan-dre Pretorius walked out to the middle at Grand Prairie Stadium and played an innings that may well define Major League Cricket’s fourth season. His 87 off 39 balls — nine fours, six sixes, a strike rate of 223 — powered the San Francisco Unicorns to a breathtaking two-wicket victory over the Seattle Orcas in Match 11, chasing down 192 with just two balls to spare.

It was the kind of innings that makes a franchise league worth watching, and the kind of finish that leaves cricket newcomers in America wondering why they hadn’t tuned in sooner.

## Seattle Sets the Target

The Seattle Orcas won the toss and elected to bat on what officials described as a spinning pitch with swing-friendly conditions. Their batters made the most of the first ten overs before the Unicorns’ bowlers clawed back — Seattle were ultimately bowled out for 191 in 19.2 overs, falling one delivery short of using their full allotment. Marcus Stoinis, who would later contribute with the ball, anchored a middle-order that featured cameos from Shimron Hetmyer and Tim Seifert. It was a competitive total, but just barely defensible.

## Pretorius Takes Charge


![Grand Prairie Stadium — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/69/Grand_Prairie_Stadium_seating%2C_April_2024.jpg/3840px-Grand_Prairie_Stadium_seating%2C_April_2024.jpg)



> **"He was picked up by the Rajasthan Royals in IPL 2026 after being the leading run-scorer at the SA20 in 2025 (397 runs, including a 97 on debut for Paarl Royals)."**



The chase belonged to Pretorius from the moment he middled his first boundary. The left-hander from Potchefstroom — the youngest man to score a Test century for South Africa, after his 153 on debut against Zimbabwe in June 2025 — played with the audacity that has made him one of the most sought-after T20 talents in world cricket.

Indian cricket fans know him well. He was picked up by the Rajasthan Royals in IPL 2026 after being the leading run-scorer at the SA20 in 2025 (397 runs, including a 97 on debut for Paarl Royals). At Grand Prairie, Pretorius was in destroy mode: nine boundaries that pierced the field, six towering sixes that cleared it, and a strike rate of 223 against a Seattle attack featuring Stoinis (4-0-29-2) and Cameron Gannon (4-0-30-2). Aaron Hardie chipped in with 28 off 20 balls, but the innings was unmistakably Pretorius’s show.

## The Collapse and the Climax

What looked like a comfortable chase turned into a crisis once Pretorius departed. The Unicorns stumbled from control to 163 for 8 in the 17th over, with Hassan Khan (16 off 10) the last recognised batter to fall. Sri Lanka’s Dasun Shanaka claimed two wickets, and South Africa’s Ottniel Baartman (4-0-39-1) dragged Seattle back into the contest.

That left Australian Brody Couch — a lower-order batter who usually lets his bowling do the talking — at the crease alongside Pakistan fast bowler Haris Rauf. The equation came down to the final over, bowled by Shanaka. Couch launched a six over midwicket, followed it with a four through the covers, then nudged a single to seal the match. His unbeaten 26 off 14 balls (two fours, two sixes) won’t dominate international highlight reels, but it won the game. The unbroken ninth-wicket stand of 29 runs across three overs was the partnership of the match.


![Shimron Hetmyer — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/8a/Shimron_Hetmyer.jpg)


## What It Means for the Table

The victory lifted the San Francisco Unicorns to the top of the MLC 2026 standings with four points from four matches (two wins, one loss, one no result) — level on points with Texas Super Kings and Seattle Orcas, but crucially with a game in hand over both. The Los Angeles Knight Riders, with just two matches played, remain lurking. With the top four qualifying for the playoffs, every result from here forward carries outsized weight.

## The Diaspora Connection

For Indian-American cricket fans — the league’s core audience — this match delivered on several fronts. Pretorius’s IPL pedigree with the Rajasthan Royals made his knock instantly relatable to a fanbase that tracks franchise T20 cricket year-round. Sanjay Krishnamurthy, an Indian-American batter, featured in the Unicorns’ playing XI. The MLC’s IPL sister-franchise connections (MI New York to Mumbai Indians, Texas Super Kings to Chennai Super Kings) continue to deepen the league’s relevance for NRI households already invested in Indian cricket.

Standing at square leg and calling the shots alongside Rushane Samuels of the West Indies was Vijaya Mallela, an Indian-American umpire representing the USA on the MLC panel — a quiet but significant marker of cricket’s expanding footprint in the country’s South Asian community.

Grand Prairie Stadium, the 7,000-capacity former minor league ballpark in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex that was converted for cricket use in 2022, sits in one of America’s fastest-growing Indian-American population centres. On Friday night, it felt like it justified the investment.
